methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: this study attempts to propose a highly practice-based Energy Management Maturity Model for China (EMMM-China)

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper proposes a qualitative energy management maturity model (EMMM-China), a maturity-assessment framework. It does not present, characterise, evaluate, or critique any specific EnPI/EnB measurement model (no identifiable measured quantity together with variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). EnPI/EnB appear only as maturity-grid descriptors and ISO 50001/50006 concept references, incidental to the model itself. Ineligible under the v2.3 maturity-assessment carve-out.

paper_type.evidence_quote: propose a highly practice-based maturity model (MM)

stage1.notes: EnPI/EnB appear only as maturity-grid descriptors (e.g. 'Some EnBs are normalized by the regression analysis') and ISO 50006 concepts, not as a characterised measurement model.
